tools.name: get_session
tools.description: Resolve the key to its mover (name, branding, config). Scope: quote.

tools.name: list_home_profiles
tools.description: Home sizes for the ballpark step (2br_apt, 3br_house, …). Scope: quote.

tools.name: ballpark_estimate
tools.description: Instant estimate range from home size + addresses. Free; never bookable. Scope: quote.

tools.name: create_job
tools.description: Start a job (the survey container). Contact details are NOT accepted here — funnel rule. Send `Idempotency-Key` so a retry cannot create a second job. Scope: jobs:write.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List jobs for the tenant, newest first. Secret key only. Paged: pass `limit` (1–100, default 25), optional `status`, and `cursor` from the previous page's `next_cursor` (null on the last page; a bad cursor is a 400). Scope: jobs:read.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Full job state: status, inventory, quote, access, terms, move_date. Scope: jobs:read.

tools.name: set_contact
tools.description: Store customer email + optional name + move date. Sends NOTHING — required before upload-url. Scope: jobs:write.

tools.name: create_upload_url
tools.description: Presigned upload for the walkthrough video. Requires stored contact email. Body: { content_type, consent, size }. Send the byte size: at or above 16 MB the response carries `multipart` (an upload_id, a part_size and a presigned PUT per part) instead of `upload`, and each part is retried on its own r

tools.name: complete_upload
tools.description: Assemble a chunked upload. Body: { upload_id, parts: [{ part_number, etag }] }. Only after every part has been PUT; then call /submit. Scope: jobs:write.

tools.name: submit_job
tools.description: Queue the uploaded video for analysis. Poll GET /jobs/{id} for status. Scope: jobs:write.

tools.name: hand_off_video
tools.description: Server-side handoff: give us a public https URL of the walkthrough instead of uploading it from a browser. Secret key only. We fetch it (up to 500 MB, streamed) and the job runs exactly as an upload would — poll GET /jobs/{id}. Needs the stored contact email and consent, like /upload-url. Replaces /

tools.name: confirm_access
tools.description: Confirm floors / elevator / stairs / carry distance for both ends. Scope: jobs:write.

tools.name: edit_items
tools.description: Edit inventory (quantity, exclude, add by item_key). Response carries the re-priced quote. Scope: jobs:write.

tools.name: approve_inventory
tools.description: Customer sign-off on the inventory, plus free-text notes. Scope: jobs:write.

tools.name: acknowledge_gaps
tools.description: Record the customer's answer to the capture-gap prompts (inventory.gaps on GET /jobs/{id}). Body: { acknowledged: true } stamps "nothing is missing"; false clears it. The prompts themselves are recomputed from the current inventory on every read, so fixing a gap removes its prompt without this call.

tools.name: send_resume_link
tools.description: Email the customer their resume link. Only on explicit request. Scope: jobs:write.

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Request the booking. Idempotent per job; requires approve:true (types-name-as-signature approval of the inventory + quote, stored with a quote snapshot) and accept_terms when the mover has terms. Scope: jobs:write.

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Report actuals (hours, final cents, crew). Secret key only. Scope: outcomes.

tools.name: get_cube_sheet_csv
tools.description: Itemized cube sheet as CSV (Excel-ready): rooms, volumes, weights, exclusions. Secret key only. Scope: jobs:read.

tools.name: get_date_prices
tools.description: This job's quote priced across a ~2-week window from the mover's date rules. flat=true means every day prices the same. Scope: jobs:read.

tools.name: set_move_date
tools.description: Set or clear the move date; invalidates and recomputes the quote. Refused after a booking is requested. Scope: jobs:write.

tools.name: quote_inventory
tools.description: Direct pricing for agents: items or total_cuft in, firm quote out. Secret key only. Scope: quote.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Which days the mover has marked off, before a job exists. Soft: a marked day can still be requested — the mover confirms and calls first — so steer to an open day when the customer has a choice. Scope: quote.

tools.name: list_keys
tools.description: List the account's API keys — live and test, active and revoked. Never a raw secret. Secret key with the `keys` scope. Scope: keys.

tools.name: create_key
tools.description: Mint a key. The raw secret is in THIS response only. A key can never mint one broader than itself; a test key mints only test keys; a live secret key may mint the sandbox pair. Scope: keys.

tools.name: rotate_key
tools.description: Replace a key with its twin (same kind, mode, scopes, label). The old key keeps working until `replaced.expires_at` so a deploy can swap values without a gap. Needs the `keys` scope even to rotate itself — rotate a scoped key with a full key or from the dashboard. A key is rotated once: rotating it

tools.name: revoke_key
tools.description: Revoke a key immediately. The only live publishable key is refused (409) — rotate it instead. A test key cannot revoke a live key (403 `mode_mismatch`). Scope: keys.

tools.name: list_webhook_deliveries
tools.description: The delivery log: every webhook POST for 30 days, newest first, with its outcome and the exact body sent. Secret key with the `keys` scope. A key reads the deliveries of its own mode: live keys the live log, test keys the sandbox log. Scope: keys.

tools.name: replay_webhook_delivery
tools.description: Re-send one delivery to its endpoint: the same body byte for byte (same envelope id, so your dedupe still works) under a fresh signature, with the usual retries. Returns the replay's own delivery record. Deliveries of the other mode are not found (404). Scope: keys.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the cube-sheet catalog (?q=sofa). Scope: quote.

tools.name: suggest_addresses
tools.description: Address autocomplete (proxied; send session_token). Scope: quote.

tools.name: resolve_address
tools.description: Resolve a suggestion to a full address (same session_token). Scope: quote.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hand_off_video, list_webhook_deliveries · Private data: create_job, list_jobs, set_contact, create_upload_url, hand_off_video, acknowledge_gaps, report_outcome, get_cube_sheet_csv, quote_inventory, list_keys, create_key, list_webhook_deliveries, replay_webhook_delivery · Public sink: create_job, set_contact, create_upload_url, complete_upload, submit_job, hand_off_video, send_resume_link, list_webhook_deliveries, replay_webhook_delivery, suggest_addresses.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hand_off_video, list_webhook_deliveries · Private data: create_job, list_jobs, set_contact, create_upload_url, hand_off_video, acknowledge_gaps, report_outcome, get_cube_sheet_csv, quote_inventory, list_keys, create_key, list_webhook_deliveries, replay_webhook_delivery · Public sink: create_job, set_contact, create_upload_url, complete_upload, submit_job, hand_off_video, send_resume_link, list_webhook_deliveries, replay_webhook_delivery, suggest_addresses

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
